icons.label: Portal / Gate
icons.description: Frame over a doorway or dock opening; items pass through on foot, forklift or conveyor.

icons.label: Conveyor / Tunnel
icons.description: Reader head over a roller conveyor — reads at full belt speed as items pass under.

icons.label: Overhead / Ceiling Mount
icons.description: Ceiling or pole mounted, antennas aimed down for continuous zone presence.

icons.label: Shelf / Embedded
icons.description: Antennas in each rack level — short read range per shelf, stock counted in place.

icons.label: Open Tabletop
icons.description: Flat antenna pad on a work surface — reads without any scanning motion.

icons.label: Shielded Enclosure
icons.description: RF-shielded chamber — the item and its reads stay contained, so accuracy is 100%.

icons.label: Room-to-Room (Doorframe)
icons.description: Antenna pairs flush in both jambs — a tight, crossing-only read zone.

icons.label: Floor-to-Floor (Lift Lobby)
icons.description: Lobby or stairwell transition; the car itself acts as a Faraday cage.

icons.label: Simple Reader
icons.description: The platform fallback — a plain reader panel emitting an RF wave.

icons.label: Middleware
icons.description: Integration bridge forwarding physical reads on to the platform.

icons.label: Manufacturing Execution System
icons.description: Emits reads on production events from the plant floor.

icons.label: Warehouse Control System
icons.description: Warehouse-side system emitting reads on conveyor, sorter and ASRS events.

icons.label: Mobile / Web Application
icons.description: Camera, NFC or manual-entry submissions from a mobile or web client.
